purpose: post-hoc explanatory attention diagnostics; no model selection or training
proxy: sample standard deviation / mean of five raw nonnegative finite wind-speed observations ending at forecast origin, spanning 60 min
threshold: 90th percentile of eligible turbine-origin coefficients on chronological training rows only
row_unit: query turbine and forecast origin; valid measured target required; candidate class from saved target event label
interpretation: 15-min historical variability proxy, not IEC turbulence intensity; not confirmed curtailment
statistics: descriptive per-seed means and sample SD, no tests or CI
direction: Pearson correlation across 28 off-diagonal keys between attention and signed alignment with the actual model NWP vector, each query row
